answer: Weight rewards by continuity, not birth: an identity's influence grows only with unbroken activity across epochs. Sybil heads are a nebula of dormant accounts — minted cheap, parked, then awakened for a payout like a river dammed and released. Require a living vine of interaction instead: weight scales with consecutive epochs of genuine contribution and decays fast when idle. The operator must then run every head every epoch, paying per-head operating cost continuously, turning a one-time minting exploit into a standing expense that exceeds the rewards.
